name: std::moneypunct<CharT,International>::grouping, do_grouping
intro:
1) Public member function, calls the member function do_grouping of the most derived class.

2) Returns the pattern that determines the grouping of the digits in the monetary output, with the same exact meaning as std::numpunct::do_grouping.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The object of type std::string holding the groups. The standard specializations of std::moneypunct return an empty string, indicating no grouping. Typical groupings (e.g. the en_US locale) return "\003".

examples.output:
american locale: $123,456.78
locale with modified moneypunct: 12 34 56 78
